title: Bows
summary: The seven SkyRPG bows, the first ranged weapons: how arrows deal damage, each bow's effect, recipes and enchants.

s.x: while the arrow flies: sparks for the Hunter's Bow, green motes for the Recurve, a thin smoke line for the Longbow, flames for the Ember Bow, snowflakes for the Frostbite Bow, electric sparks for the Stormcaller and stardust for the Starfall Bow.
the moment a bow reaches full draw there is a glint at the arrow and a soft chime, so you know when to let go. A full-draw shot kicks the screen a little.

every arrow lands with a flash, a ring and sparks; the Ember Bow's is a fireball with embers and smoke, the Frostbite Bow's shatters ice, the Starfall Bow's bursts into stars and the Longbow's is a clean white streak.
the Longbow's arrow flies through its first target and hits the next one, each for full damage.
a fire arrow sets what it hits alight, and bursts, hurting every hostile mob within 2.5 blocks for 60% of the hit. The burst never destroys blocks or starts fires on the ground.
the Frostbite Bow's hit slows the target to a crawl and frosts it for 3 seconds, which also makes it easy to hit again.
shots. The third one, then the sixth, and so on, calls a bolt of lightning on the target for 80% of the hit on top of it. Half-drawn shots do not count and do not reset the count.

the Starfall Bow's three arrows fan out a few degrees. Each deals 55% of the bow's Damage (a full hit with all three is 165%), and they bend towards enemies in front of them, so close shots on a single target often land all three.
The Ember Bow's burst makes it the bow for groups, the Longbow for lines of mobs in corridors, the Frostbite Bow for fast or dangerous melee mobs and bosses you want to keep at range.

Bow enchants (Deadeye, Longshot, Quiversong, Splitshot, Starshot, Cinder Arrows) can all be put on SkyRPG bows. Strength and crit stats from armour, accessories and talents apply to arrows too, so a melee build is a good ranged build as well.
